notes: The opening waw takes the postposed *also*, which rule 51 settles wherever a waw is present, so nothing in the first colon is added; the second waw takes its own *And*.
`רַנֵּן` takes the separate adverbial *aloud* under rule 56, and the finite cognate verb keeps *shall shout ... for joy*, headed on *shout* as at PSA.132.9.
